title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U): All items, Urban Hawaii (semiannual, 1982-84=100)
limitations: Urban Hawaii CPI is published semiannually (S01/S02), not monthly — within-year volatility is smoothed by construction.

BLS only publishes Urban Hawaii from 2017 (the area restructure). Values for 2010-2016 are RATE-CHAINED: the prior anchor file's year-over-year rates applied backward to the 2017 Urban Hawaii level. Those rates are legacy and could not be re-verified against a live BLS series — treat pre-2017 levels as approximate.

Rebuilt 2026-07-27. The previous file declared series_id CUUSA426SA0 / CUUSA426SEHA, which BLS reports do not exist; its values matched no live series (the all-items version converged to Los Angeles by 2024, consistent with the CUURS49ASA0 mislabelling corrected in bls/panel.py).
Series uses a 1982-84 base; rebasing within the BLS reference series is rare but possible.
Urban Hawaii is a state-wide urban aggregate — it is broader than Honolulu proper and does not resolve individual counties.
